wake_source.responsibility: Start a fresh reasoning invocation at the next supported opportunity.
wake_source.must_not_be_treated_as: proof that predecessor stayed alive or permission for dual substantive authority

reasoning_worker.responsibility: Perform useful checkpointable work while invocation exists.

durable_continuation.responsibility: Persist exact resumable state and side-effect evidence after meaningful units.

supervisor_measurement.responsibility: Measure useful coverage and scheduler/startup gaps without inference.

scheduler_budget.rule: For a normal 10 minutes (600 seconds) nonterminal CONTINUE turn, arm SAME MAIN once at observed wake/arm reference + exactly 11 minutes (660 seconds). Early/late provider timing alone never suppresses safe work. Normal close currently canaries SAME MAIN ACTUAL END + exactly 2 minutes (120 seconds), preserving full recurring RRULE and enabled=true. Historical +60-second samples remain comparison evidence.

startup_receipt_generation_fence.rule: A stale receipt from an earlier occurrence cannot satisfy current startup acknowledgement.

response: do not infer useful work across the gap
recover at next available verified wake

rolling_recovery.startup: minimum fence, persist generation-matched BOOT_STARTED, arm and verify SAME MAIN + exactly 11 minutes (660 seconds) provisional, then claim authority if safe
rolling_recovery.normal_close: checkpoint then live-verify SAME MAIN full recurring VEVENT at ACTUAL END + exactly 2 minutes (120 seconds); do not arm Watchdog
rolling_recovery.mutation_failure: retry same full RRULE update once when safe; preserve older verified recurring fallback rather than create replacement
rolling_recovery.stale_occurrence: recover forward without replacing canonical; timing mismatch alone is not a fence

time_unit_safety.rule: Human-readable timing must include explicit units and exact seconds for critical relay timings.
